svg.text: Generated by tools/figures/integrations_readme.py from the item definition, PX4Integration.sysml, SSFs and SITL results. Proposed integration: not implemented, integrated or verified; SITL is synthetic with no evidence credit.

g.text: Terms: IF-nnn = interface in the item definition (architecture/item-definition.yaml) · IF-PX4-nnn = PX4 integration interface (integrations/px4/interface-contract.md) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SITL

= software-in-the-loop simulation · SSF-nnn = safety-significant software function record (safety/software/) · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-A1-FC = PX4-based flight controller · SUS-A1-NAV = navigation sensors, camera and telemetry · SUS-A1-PWR =

UAV battery and power management · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1-CTL = mission, motion and balance control · SUS-M1-DCK = UAV dock, retention, charging and release · SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and
